steps.name: Crownslayer
steps.text: Mephisto?
You have no reason to object, right? Just a few insects that flew too close to the light... are they really worth your time?
My troops have already received your info. You've already done your part.
All that's left for you to do is to go home. After all, you're just responsible for the core energy sector and its surroundings...

steps.name: Crownslayer
steps.text: Don't do anything unnecessary...!
You still have somewhere else to be, don't you?

steps.name: Crownslayer
steps.text: Fine. Have it your way.

steps.name: Crownslayer
steps.text: I can't wait to see you fail.

steps.name: Crownslayer
steps.text: We're leaving.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: One of the enemy leaders... just took a portion of the Reunion troops and left?

steps.name: Dobermann
steps.text: What are they up to?

steps.name: Dobermann
steps.text: Whatever it is, we can't let our guard down... The enemy is still many times our size!
Well, well. Please allow me to apologize on Crownslayer's behalf for her rudeness.

steps.name: Mephisto
steps.text: You can call me Mephisto.

steps.name: Dobermann
steps.text: What is Reunion trying to accomplish?

steps.name: Mephisto
steps.text: Oh, nothing in particular. To be honest, I wouldn't even mind letting you bunch go. You weren't even our targets in the first place.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: If we weren't your targets, then why...

steps.name: Mephisto
steps.text: However, I had the honor of watching your battles.

steps.name: Mephisto
steps.text: Your combat tactics as well as your personnel configuration were quite intriguing.

steps.name: Medic
steps.text: ...Intriguing?

steps.name: Medic
steps.text: You think that the carnage of battle is... intriguing?

steps.name: Mephisto
steps.text: Rhodes Island... I've read up on your group before.

steps.name: Mephisto
steps.text: At first, I thought you were just another ordinary company.

steps.name: Mephisto
steps.text: But by the looks of things, don't you think your ambitions have stretched a bit too far from playing with test tubes?

steps.name: Mephisto
steps.text: It'd be terribly dull if I allowed you to just walk out of here, wouldn't it?

steps.name: Mephisto
steps.text: What I'd like is to have a little competition, a ritual of sorts.

steps.name: Dobermann
steps.text: ...We don't have time to waste on a preoperational kid.

steps.name: Dobermann
steps.text: (Amiya, get ready. We might have to break through with force.)

steps.name: Dobermann
steps.text: (I'll get his attention...!)

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: (Mm, okay!)

steps.name: Mephisto
steps.text: ...What was that just now? Who were you sending a signal to?

steps.name: Dobermann
steps.text: None of your business, kid.

steps.name: Dobermann
steps.text: (Amiya?)

steps.name: Mephisto
steps.text: Come on, we're all professionals here. Where's your basic courtesy?

steps.name: Dobermann
steps.text: If people like you didn't exist, I wouldn't have to constantly be honing my insults!

steps.name: Dobermann
steps.text: (Amiya, what's going on?)

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: (Dobermann... All of our escape routes have been blocked by his troops!)

steps.name: Dobermann
steps.text: (How can that be?! How did he manage to do that in just a few minutes--)

steps.name: Mephisto
steps.text: This simply won't do.

steps.name: Mephisto
steps.text: Even though I gave you my sincere invitation...

steps.name: Mephisto
steps.text: But all you can think of...

steps.name: Mephisto
steps.text: ...is running away?!

steps.name: Dobermann
steps.text: Tsk...!

steps.name: Mephisto
steps.text: Actually, I'll let you leave my hunting grounds safely as long as you win.

steps.name: Mephisto
steps.text: Until then, my friends here will keep trying to kill you.

steps.name: Mephisto
steps.text: It's your victory as long as you don't die! The rules are simple enough, right?

steps.name: Dobermann
steps.text: Ace!

steps.name: Ace
steps.text: We're already prepared to break through.

steps.name: Ace
steps.text: But we have to stave off their attacks first!

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Why are you doing this? The Catastrophe is coming! If we don't leave Chernobog, then everyone will--

steps.name: Mephisto
steps.text: What are you talking about...

steps.name: Mephisto
steps.text: The Catastrophe... makes it the best time to celebrate.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: You're sick...

steps.name: Mephisto
steps.text: My esteemed guests, I am honored to invite you to this game.

steps.name: Reunion Member
steps.text: Argh... Argh...!

steps.name: Reunion Member
steps.text: Kill... Kill! ! Kill... them all!!

steps.name: Dobermann
steps.text: Amiya! Watch out!

steps.name: Mephisto
steps.text: Right, right...

steps.name: Mephisto
steps.text: Actually, we know exactly what you did in the central area.

steps.name: Mephisto
steps.text: That masked person you rescued... makes me very, very curious.

steps.name: Mephisto
steps.text: Crownslayer is so fixated on what you're going to do next, where you're going to go.

steps.name: Mephisto
steps.text: But I'm different. What I care about is...

steps.name: Mephisto
steps.text: What exactly are you? Where are you from?

steps.name: Mephisto
steps.text: Yes, you. The one staring at me right now... You are somewhat different from us.

steps.name: Mephisto
steps.text: What was the device in that facility that was able to preserve your life?

steps.name: Mephisto
steps.text: I am so, very curious.

steps.name: Mephisto
steps.text: See, I'm not such a cold-blooded person...

steps.name: Mephisto
steps.text: So how about it, my esteemed Rhodes Island guests, how about giving this person to me as a gift?

steps.name: Mephisto
steps.text: It would be a shame to end the game early, but at least I'll let the rest of you go. How about it?

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Doctor...

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Get behind me!!
